abstract: A self-contained checkpoint of the canonical 00:11 SATCOM estimator, typed posterior handoff, conditional end-of-flight impact families, optional external-evidence sensitivities, and provisional residual-search planning. Every result is labelled by evidential status and structural model family.

blockers.effect: Public data do not identify a calibrated joint probability distribution for high-angle-of-attack aerodynamics, control degradation, fuel-feed split, APU pickup, and SDU restart behavior.
blockers.release_treatment: Emit explicit deterministic conditional families; do not assign cross-family probabilities or pool their impacts.

items.outcome: The canonical 00:11 BTO-only and medium-BFO families are reproducible across five seeds; received-power gain is emitted separately as a conditional family.
remaining: Structural lateral-mode alternatives remain separate and are not assigned model probabilities.
items.title: 00:11 integrated SATCOM estimator

items.outcome: The versioned 00:11 posterior handoff preserves state, BFO bias, identity, weights, provenance, model family, and evidence consumption into the R600 continuation.
remaining: Fuel and electrical histories remain explicit downstream inputs rather than fields smuggled into AircraftState.
items.title: Typed posterior handoff

items.outcome: A deterministic, ERA5-driven 00:11-to-impact family suite is released. The primary conditional proxy uses Martin Arc-1 fuel, Kong as a coarse fuel cross-check, and the current public-aerodynamics best-glide family; all alternatives remain separately labelled and unpooled.
remaining: Replace public proxy aerodynamics and conditional system schedules when validated B777-specific data become available.
items.title: 00:11-to-impact physics

items.outcome: The final SATCOM contract selects the seventh arc with corrected R600 BTO once and keeps the startup/channel observations separate pending transient calibration.
remaining: Empirically calibrate the R1200 timing offset and short-outage OCXO/channel transient before likelihood admission.
items.title: Final SATCOM evidence contract

items.outcome: Within the primary conditional proxy, the weighted mean is 38.1596°S, 89.4088°E; median post-00:11 displacement is 106.91 NM, mean horizontal/downward impact speeds are 88.46/6.66 m/s, mean impact angle is 4.31°, and mean kinetic energy is 0.686 GJ. The conditional-gain source shifts the weighted impact mean by only 0.3 NM within this family.
remaining: Interpret impact PDFs only within their named end-of-flight structural family.
items.title: Impact PDFs and terminal dynamics

metrics: Pléiades branches fail closed at 150,000 particles
items.outcome: All five optional location-surface branches execute, but v0.1 assigns them zero estimator weight. The four Pléiades branches fail numerical resolution (150,000-particle ESS 5.63–9.14); CMEMS is numerically usable but its source contract is admitted=false. Hydroacoustics remains predictive-only, and RNZAF coordinates are contextual metadata rather than evidence.
remaining: Do not multiply Pléiades components or combine a component with their uncalibrated mixture.
Do not apply the current ocean-drift family to the central estimator.
items.title: Optional external-evidence branches

items.outcome: The evidence atlas separates official geometry, reported-but-unplotted totals, approximate Ocean Infinity outlines, and AIS context. The baseline primary-impact sensitivity selects twelve 625 km2 tiles containing 38.51% of its KDE mass and supplies a ranked extension sequence. Four Pléiades plans are numerically unresolved and the ocean plan is diagnostic-only; none is operational guidance or a negative-search posterior.
remaining: Exact swaths, survey holidays, and probability-of-detection calibration are needed before negative-search reweighting.
items.title: Residual search planning

title: MH370 integrated Bayesian estimator — v0.1 release milestone

validation.detail: cargo fmt --all -- --check passed; cargo test --workspace passed 202 tests with four external-data tests intentionally ignored.

Strict all-target Clippy remains non-clean only on known style lints: one derivable Default in dynamics; four too-many-arguments, one double-ended last, and three needless as_bytes in reporting; one too-many-arguments in end-of-flight. Frozen science code was not changed for documentation-only cleanup.
Frozen runner, source tree, suite, report, generator, matrix, and base-config identities are recorded; report artifacts were generated from suite outputs without hand edits.
All five branch manifests reproduce. Pléiades remains display-only after the 150,000-particle audit; CMEMS is diagnostic because admitted=false; central weights are unchanged.

Five 30,000-particle seeds passed the declared convergence limits. Maximum seed-mean separation was 2.49 NM for BTO, 3.33 NM for medium BFO, and 1.36 NM for conditional gain; log-evidence ranges were 0.029, 0.136, and 0.110 nats.
The run manifest verifies 85 outputs and locks the configuration, all compact inputs, and exact executable identity.
Focused schema tests and an exact in-memory versus JSON-serialize/read/continue numerical regression passed; duplicate evidence consumption is rejected.
Six source-workflow checks, deterministic hashes, and artifact-hygiene checks passed. The likelihood-producing API remains absent.

The handoff suite passed 5/5 and the RNZAF suite passed 5/5; SHA256SUMS verified. Component surfaces and the uncalibrated mixture have separate canonical hashes and a machine-enforced no-pooling contract.

Full-domain replications, replay, isotope screen, and ledger checks completed. The surface failed out-of-support, every-recovery ESS, and replication-stability criteria and is therefore retained as diagnostic_zero_weight.

Source build.py check passed. The deterministic aggregate over all 76 canonical files in the six planning-release directories is cefaf5a86f8ea0630da39873ee9a916940542497ae6f36ea1e125c0c5d0e898d. Figures were visually reviewed and manifests contain no host paths.
